key_idea: Write down every pair, add it, and count the sums that are different.
steps: The numbers are 1, 3, 4, 7 and 8. There are 10 ways to pick 2 of them.
The sum 11 shows up 2 times. So there are 10 - 1 = 9 different sums.

choice_feedback.A: Too few. The different sums are 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 15. That is 9.
choice_feedback.B: Too few. The different sums are 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 15. That is 9.
choice_feedback.C: Only one sum shows up twice: 11. So there are 9 different sums, not 8.
choice_feedback.E: There are 10 pairs, but 3 + 8 and 4 + 7 both make 11. So only 9 sums are different.
